scope: Existing RAW PNG and existing SVG preview only. Independent original-pixel inventory was saved before after-inventory.json or candidates were read. Source prose remains D269-owned.

inputBindings.paths: Original path is in source-inventory.json. Figure, preview, preview-receipt, page, audit and native-result paths are referenced from the hash-verified after-inventory.json; no input snapshots were copied.
inputBindings.verification: One hash/byte verification per input: 19 frozen files and four relevant nested native receipts, all matched. Output inventory and source crop were each hashed once; report is hashed once after writing.

findings: One apparatus, not subdivided: horseshoe magnet/pole faces, perspective coil/frame and axle, adjacent ring/contact forms and two dangling leads remain in both representations.
The right N-shaped and shaded opposite-pole mark, left curved rotation arrow/head, coil edges and contact strokes are present; no added terminal, meter or circuit appears.
Caption/body prose excluded; full magnet, rotation mark and lead tips retained. Small isolated source specks are not prose contamination.
limitations: Source shading makes internal brush connectivity and the opposite-pole encoded glyph uncertain; preserved visible shapes are the review basis, not an inferred netlist.
SVG smooths raster edges and suppresses some tiny scan pinholes. No instructional component, glyph shape or arrow loss was observed; this is not pixel-identical vectorization approval.

findings: Single closed LC: three perspective coil loops at left, top/bottom return conductors and two distinct perspective capacitor plates at right.
Upper wire joins upper plate, lower plate joins lower return, capacitor gap remains separated; no battery/switch/charge label/arrow/extra terminal was invented.
Full loop and both plates retained; body prose and separate main caption excluded. A small lower-right scan speck remains a speck, not a terminal.
limitations: SVG smooths doubled scan edges and coil/plate texture without an observed topology change; original scan does not support a modern standardized circuit reinterpretation.

blockingFindings.location: Approximate canvas x480..597, y270..283 at the lower edge; original page around x675..792, y1982..1995.
blockingFindings.finding: The upper fragment of the separate main figure caption is included, then abruptly clipped by the canvas bottom. This is not the shared a-shaped or right be-shaped subdivision label.
blockingFindings.basis: Observed in both existing images and in original50. Exact source-crop comparison confirms the PNG inherits this crop boundary; existing SVG preview carries the same caption fragment.
blockingFindings.effect: RAW diagram crop fails caption-boundary cleanliness despite otherwise retained instructional topology.
blockingFindings.actionTaken: Report only; no recrop, rerender, repair or publication.

nonblockingFindings: Two circuits share exactly one a-shaped mark; spring/mass retains a separate be-shaped mark. No subdivision was split, relabeled or invented.
Both circuits retain two-cell battery strokes/dashed continuation, bottom capacitor junction, four-lobed coil, circular switch pivot and contact numerals 1/2.
Left blade reaches contact 1 and leaves 2 open; right blade reaches 2 and leaves 1 open, preserving the charging versus closed capacitor/coil configurations.
Each capacitor retains four upper plus shapes, four lower minus strokes, q-like/M-shaped upper charge group and leading-minus lower charge group at their original relative locations.

Spring support, complete zigzag, shaded mass below equilibrium, broken equilibrium/reference line, lower mass-level horizontal stroke and right vertical displacement stroke with arrowhead-like regions are retained.
Small upper tilted/two-level glyph and lower x-like glyph remain beside the displacement stroke. Equilibrium-label shape remains below the broken line; no text transcription adjudication.

The broken reference line remains separate from the electrical coil; no added connector, terminal, sinusoidal graph, grid or value. No observed loss of circuit strokes, mass, subdivision marks or arrow tails.
limitations: Tiny displacement and charge subscripts are preserved as shapes; impossible Latin/Cyrillic encoding identity is not a RAW requirement.
Source spring bends/arrowheads and vector-smoothed scan texture do not establish precise displacement values or separately countable attachment turns.
The caption defect is independently sufficient to fail both representations; native-pass and exact-crop equality do not override it.

reusedEvidence.structuralCheck: Each existing SVG has one path, zero text elements and zero embedded raster images. SVG viewBox and existing preview dimensions match the respective PNG canvas. No renderer was invoked.
reusedEvidence.pixelCheck: ImageChops comparison against the three source rectangles gave no difference bounding box. Disk-only pixel/metadata checks emitted no image payloads.

executionNote: The first local crop attempt stopped before reading an image because system Python lacked Pillow; the existing lesson virtualenv then created the sole source crop. No install, native pipeline call, extra visual open or candidate change occurred.
